name: type_inference_inheritance.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (dog Ref)(cat Ref)(inferredBreed String)(inferredIndoor Bool)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Animal (mk-Animal (age Int)(name String)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Dog (mk-Dog (age Int)(name String)(breed String)(dogBreed String)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Cat (mk-Cat (age Int)(name String)(indoor Bool)(isIndoor Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Animal (sel-Animal Animal))
  (lift-Dog (sel-Dog Dog))
  (lift-Cat (sel-Cat Cat))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Animal ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Animal (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Animal ((this Ref)) Animal
  (sel-Animal (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Dog ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Dog (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Dog ((this Ref)) Dog
  (sel-Dog (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Cat ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Cat (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Cat ((this Ref)) Cat
  (sel-Cat (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Animal ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Animal this)
    (deref-is-Dog this)
    (deref-is-Cat this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Dog ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Dog this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Cat ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Cat this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.dog: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!dog ((this Ref)) Ref
  (dog (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.cat: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!cat ((this Ref)) Ref
  (cat (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.inferredBreed: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!inferredBreed ((this Ref)) String
  (inferredBreed (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.inferredIndoor: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!inferredIndoor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (inferredIndoor (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Animal:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Animal.age: ---

(define-fun Animal!age ((this Ref)) Int
  (age (deref-Animal this))
)

; --- getters for Animal.name: ---

(define-fun Animal!name ((this Ref)) String
  (name (deref-Animal this))
)

; --------------------------
;   Getters for class Dog:
; --------------------------

; --- getters for Dog.age: ---

(define-fun Dog!age ((this Ref)) Int
  (age (deref-Dog this))
)

; --- getters for Dog.name: ---

(define-fun Dog!name ((this Ref)) String
  (name (deref-Dog this))
)

; --- getters for Dog.breed: ---

(define-fun Dog.breed ((this Ref)) String
  (breed (deref-Dog this))
)

(define-fun Dog!breed ((this Ref)) String
  (breed (deref-Dog this))
)

; --- getters for Dog.dogBreed: ---

(define-fun Dog!dogBreed ((this Ref)) String
  (dogBreed (deref-Dog this))
)

; --------------------------
;   Getters for class Cat:
; --------------------------

; --- getters for Cat.age: ---

(define-fun Cat!age ((this Ref)) Int
  (age (deref-Cat this))
)

; --- getters for Cat.name: ---

(define-fun Cat!name ((this Ref)) String
  (name (deref-Cat this))
)

; --- getters for Cat.indoor: ---

(define-fun Cat.indoor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (indoor (deref-Cat this))
)

(define-fun Cat!indoor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (indoor (deref-Cat this))
)

; --- getters for Cat.isIndoor: ---

(define-fun Cat!isIndoor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (isIndoor (deref-Cat this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!inferredBreed this) (Dog.breed (TopLevelDeclarations!dog this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!inferredIndoor this) (Cat.indoor (TopLevelDeclarations!cat this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Dog (TopLevelDeclarations!dog this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Cat (TopLevelDeclarations!cat this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Dog.breed (TopLevelDeclarations!dog this)) "mixed")
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Cat.indoor (TopLevelDeclarations!cat this)) true)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Animal:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Animal Animal)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Animal.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Animal!age this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Animal.inv1 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Animal.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Animal!name this) "unknown")
)

(assert (! (Animal.inv2 1) :named _xkassert7))



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Dog:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Dog Dog)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Dog.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Dog!age this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Dog.inv1 2) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Dog.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Dog!name this) "unknown")
)

(assert (! (Dog.inv2 2) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Dog.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Dog!breed this) "mixed")
)

(assert (! (Dog.inv3 2) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Dog.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Dog!dogBreed this) (Dog!breed this))
)

(assert (! (Dog.inv4 2) :named _xkassert11))



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Cat:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Cat Cat)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Cat.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Cat!age this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Cat.inv1 3) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Cat.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Cat!name this) "unknown")
)

(assert (! (Cat.inv2 3) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Cat.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Cat!indoor this) true)
)

(assert (! (Cat.inv3 3) :named _xkassert14))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Cat.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Cat!isIndoor this) (Cat!indoor this))
)

(assert (! (Cat.inv4 3) :named _xkassert15))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Animal const-1-Animal))
        2 (lift-Dog const-2-Dog))
        3 (lift-Cat const-3-Cat))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-Cat () Cat
  (mk-Cat 0 "unknown" true true))
(define-fun const-2-Dog () Dog
  (mk-Dog 0 "unknown" "mixed" "mixed"))
(define-fun const-1-Animal () Animal
  (mk-Animal 0 "unknown"))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 3 "mixed" true))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (= (name (sel-Cat (select heap 3))) "unknown"))
(define-fun _xkassert14 () Bool
  (= (indoor (sel-Cat (select heap 3))) true))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (age (sel-Animal (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (name (sel-Animal (select heap 1))) "unknown"))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (dog (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Dog a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (cat (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (indoor (sel-Cat a!1)) true)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (name (sel-Dog (select heap 2))) "unknown"))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (dog (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (inferredBreed (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
     (breed (sel-Dog a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (= (age (sel-Dog (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (= (breed (sel-Dog (select heap 2))) "mixed"))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (= (age (sel-Cat (select heap 3))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (cat (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Cat a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (= (dogBreed (sel-Dog (select heap 2))) (breed (sel-Dog (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert15 () Bool
  (= (isIndoor (sel-Cat (select heap 3))) (indoor (sel-Cat (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (cat (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (inferredIndoor (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
     (indoor (sel-Cat a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (dog (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (breed (sel-Dog a!1)) "mixed")))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 3 "mixed" true)))
                  1
                  (lift-Animal (mk-Animal 0 "unknown")))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-Dog (mk-Dog 0 "unknown" "mixed" "mixed")))
         3
         (lift-Cat (mk-Cat 0 "unknown" true true)))))
